item.description: How to design agentic AI research workflows with good tools, tight briefs and evidence trails, keeping interpretation human.

item.description: How reasoning models help reconcile dashboards, diagnose performance and write honest measurement narratives grounded in profit.

item.title: Marketing Team Design for the Reasoning Era
item.description: Reasoning models move the bottleneck from production to framing, evidence and judgment. The roles and rhythm a modern marketing team needs.
